task_anchor.goal: Extend the exact passed PR1D chain with AI-native change continuity while preserving current repository truth, exact Brain Review and PR CI, exact Merge Candidate Freeze, applicable User Acceptance, separate final merge authorization, and optional post-merge navigation.
task_anchor.desired_result: Deliver a cold-reviewable cumulative PR1E candidate where Brain Review PASS plus current PR CI PASS produces an exact Merge Candidate Freeze, applicable User Acceptance binds that Freeze, final merge authorization is a separate exact-object user decision, and any Merged Change Projection is optional post-merge navigation that cannot replace or gate current repository facts.
non_goals: Do not create a persistent task-lifecycle service, path-discovery service, repository cache, global scheduler or multi-task isolation system.
Do not implement user identity authentication or cryptographic approval.
Do not implement immutable parent history or trusted observer services.
Do not implement Repository Cache or long-term repository context.
Do not declare a formal Joyflow baseline.

planning_context.parent_goal: Improve Joyflow while preserving the human semi-automatic authority topology.

material_operating_assumptions.assumption: This candidate is used by one Web Brain and one bounded Codex execution layer.
material_operating_assumptions.material_effect: Do not introduce multi-agent authority or autonomous promotion.
material_operating_assumptions.reopen_trigger: The user explicitly authorizes an architecture change.

relevant_prior_behaviors.statement: Current repository and exact current objects remain authoritative over historical navigation.
relevant_prior_behaviors.why_relevant: PR2 planning must preserve Phase 1 current-object truth while extending continuity.

exit_conditions: The current change-unit goal is closed without changing authority topology.
Any material residual is explicitly declared rather than silently deferred.

transition_event.reason: Advance after the previous human or technical gate completed.

semantic_items.meaning: Joyflow uses repository canonical state for long-term project truth and a temporary task capsule for current-task closure.

effects.value: The repaired package expresses a repository-anchored dual-layer closure model.
Implement the Repository Canonical State, temporary Fibered Task Capsule, and high-fidelity Projection Gate.
The package mechanically separates persistent repository truth from temporary task state.

semantic_items.meaning: The task capsule is temporary and must not become a second project truth source.

effects.value: The repository remains the only persistent project truth.
Do not persist the full task capsule as project canonical state.
Post-merge retention is limited to a minimal result pointer when useful.

semantic_items.meaning: Task continuity prevents ordinary packet mismatch but does not claim an immutable or adversary-proof history.

effects.value: Bind revisions and repairs to the exact prior packet when a new revision is sealed.
A changed packet cannot silently reuse the prior packet identity or approval binding.

semantic_items.meaning: Material semantics must generate exact boundary and validation obligations through typed effects.

effects.value: Generate boundary obligations and validation obligations as digest-bound projections of semantic effects.
Contradictory or unbound boundaries and validation cases are rejected.

semantic_items.derivation: Derived from prior stranger cold review and the confirmed high-fidelity transport goal.

semantic_items.meaning: Repository execution requires confirmed repository-relative paths and task-specific evidence slots.

effects.value: Require confirmed allowed paths and task-specific repository fact slots before repository execution.
Brain reads GitHub first; only materially missing local or runtime path facts route to bounded Codex read-only discovery; missing or authority-mismatched repository evidence blocks execution.

semantic_items.derivation: Derived from repository boundary bypasses and the approved minimal fact-slot compromise.

semantic_items.meaning: Path discovery is GitHub-first; Codex supplements only materially missing local or runtime facts, and the Brain owns the final path boundary.

effects.value: Use current GitHub repository evidence first; request bounded local read-only discovery only when GitHub is insufficient or unavailable.
Codex must not mutate the repository or decide final allowed paths during local discovery.
A read-only Path Discovery Return binds the current Projection and declares mutation_performed false.

semantic_items.meaning: Codex is the bounded execution technical authority for current repository and runtime facts; it may choose equivalent implementation details within the approved semantics and paths, and must stop with evidence when the Brain route is technically wrong or the approved scope is insufficient.

effects.value: Perform an internal technical preflight in the same execution turn and record any equivalent implementation decisions.
Do not change product semantics, architecture, approved paths, Brain review, user states or merge authority.
A blocked technical objection is source-bound, may omit PR or artifact evidence, and cannot be promoted by Brain review to PASS.

semantic_items.meaning: Mutation/material execution requires explicit user approval of the exact current object; bounded pure read-only Codex discovery instead uses exact Web Brain authorization and creates no user approval state. Codex may never elevate either authorization state.

effects.value: Bind mutation/material execution as APPROVED_FINAL/CURRENT_EXPLICIT_USER_DECISION, while READ_ONLY_DISCOVERY binds AUTHORIZED_READ_ONLY_DISCOVERY/WEB_BRAIN_BOUNDED_READ_ONLY_DISCOVERY_AUTHORIZATION.
The Runtime validates route-appropriate authorization ownership and exact binding; read-only Brain authorization cannot authorize mutation and mutation still requires current explicit user approval.

semantic_items.meaning: Execution approval does not authorize merge; Brain review, user acceptance and a separate user merge decision remain human semi-automatic gates.

effects.value: A candidate PR is never treated as repository canonical state.
Codex and the execution compiler must not merge or set MERGE_ALLOWED.
Merge records are owned by the Web Brain and bind the exact reviewed PR head and current user merge decision.

semantic_items.meaning: Each material reclosure / authorization cycle has one current task; each same-cycle execution attempt has one current Projection, Codex Return and Evidence Bundle.

effects.value: Bind project, task, round, Projection, Codex Return and Evidence Bundle as one current-round object chain.
An earlier round or different packet cannot substitute for the current round, and no global scheduler is introduced.

semantic_items.meaning: Derived Gates must block illegal stage progress rather than merely display status.

effects.value: Require the corresponding PASS gates before entering Brain review, user acceptance, merge decision or task closure.
A BLOCK, NEEDS_BRAIN_REVIEW or NEEDS_USER_ACCEPTANCE state prevents the next material stage.

semantic_items.derivation: Derived from the latest stranger cold review finding that blocked gates could still advance.

semantic_items.meaning: Codex Return and raw execution evidence form one digest-bound current-round Evidence Bundle.

effects.value: Bind the Codex Return to the exact current-round Evidence Bundle digest and validation-check subjects.
Replacing the Evidence Bundle or using a prior-round object invalidates the Return and Brain review binding.

semantic_items.derivation: Derived from ordinary Return/Evidence file mismatch risk.

semantic_items.meaning: Repository and Artifact execution use different review targets without changing Brain or user authority.

effects.value: Review repository work against a PR head and Artifact work against artifact identity, digest and validation evidence.
Artifact repair closes without fabricated PR evidence; repository work cannot use an Artifact target.

semantic_items.derivation: Derived from the Artifact review dead-end in the prior candidate.

semantic_items.meaning: Final USER merge authorization binds the exact Merge Candidate Freeze and applicable post-freeze User Acceptance; a changed PR head invalidates the prior freeze and authorization.

effects.value: Carry the exact current Projection, Return, Evidence Bundle, Brain Review and PR CI into the Merge Candidate Freeze, then bind applicable User Acceptance and final USER merge authorization to that exact freeze.
A merge authorization bound to another freeze, acceptance disposition or PR head is rejected; MERGE_READY / MERGE_ALLOWED are derived results only.

semantic_items.derivation: Derived from ordinary merge object-binding mismatch risk.

semantic_items.meaning: User identity authentication, immutable event chains, trusted observer services and automatic promotion are outside the current Joyflow architecture.

effects.value: Do not add user signatures, immutable event databases, trusted GitHub observers or automatic merge/promotion.
The package explicitly marks these mechanisms outside the current threat model and makes no completion claim for them.

semantic_items.meaning: Repository Cache, persistent capsule memory and long-term repository context remain deferred.

effects.value: Do not implement Repository Cache, persistent capsule memory or long-term repository context in Phase 1.
The package marks repository-context systems as deferred and makes no completion claim for them.

reviewer_basis: Reviewed active meanings, typed effects, risk markers and lanes.
